test_title: PYST 21: Selection Post (Matric Level) - English Language (Held On 27 June, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: english
question: Where does the world rustle, according to the given passage?

options.text: Over the forest in the sunny days
In the highest boughs of trees
In the deepest roots of trees

solution:
The correct answer is **"In the highest boughs of trees​."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

 

 
• The reason the correct answer is **"In the highest boughs of trees"** is because the passage specifically mentions that "In their highest boughs the world rustles."
 
• This metaphorical language suggests that the sounds or sensations of the world can be perceived in the highest parts of the trees, indicating a connection between the trees and the broader environment.
 
• It symbolizes the idea that trees, particularly in their towering heights, are in tune with the world around them.
 
• The correct answer is **Option 3**.
